capability.summary: Generate an 800-character Pygments HTML highlight preview
capability.description: Looks up a Pygments lexer by language alias, highlights one code string with the default HtmlFormatter, and returns only the first 800 characters of the generated HTML.
capability.problem_space: Short HTML previews of syntax-highlighted source code for a caller-specified Pygments lexer alias.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: source-code string and language alias; output: wrapper JSON with at most 800 characters of Pygments HTML under html.
accepted_inputs: source code or text as a string
a lexer alias recognized by Pygments get_lexer_by_name, defaulting to python when omitted
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pygments_highlight", and html as the first at most 800 characters of the default HtmlFormatter output. A caught lexer-lookup or highlighting exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pygments_highlight", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: hard-truncates generated HTML at 800 characters, which can cut through tags and produce an invalid or incomplete fragment
uses the default HtmlFormatter with no caller-selectable style, line numbers, wrapping, or formatting options
does not include a generated CSS stylesheet; default output relies on Pygments CSS class names
when supplied, language must be a lexer alias recognized by Pygments; direct wrapper invocation defaults an omitted language to python, although the manifest input contract retains required=true
unknown aliases and highlighting failures use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: First 800 characters of default Pygments HtmlFormatter output; truncation may leave incomplete HTML.

intent_tags: highlight code using a Pygments language alias
negative_intents: generate a complete large highlighted document
return a standalone styled HTML page or CSS stylesheet

output_contract.description: First 800 characters of default Pygments HtmlFormatter output; truncation may leave incomplete HTML.
